```{r}
##We will perform differential abundance with maaslin2

##Will use physeq_no_growout3_css created in "Beta diversity.Rmd"

```

```{r}
#library(Maaslin2)

# 1) Extract & prepare tables (CSS counts already in phyloseq)
prep <- function(phy) {
  df_raw     <- as.data.frame(otu_table(phy))
  df_round   <- df_raw
  df_round[] <- lapply(df_round, round)    # integerize for count models
  meta       <- as(sample_data(phy), "data.frame")
  list(raw=df_raw, round=df_round, meta=meta)
}

# subset by growout
phy_g1 <- subset_samples(physeq_no_growout3_css, Growout=="1")
phy_g2 <- subset_samples(physeq_no_growout3_css, Growout=="2")

dat1 <- prep(phy_g1)
dat2 <- prep(phy_g2)

# 2) Define the eight model‐specs
models <- expand.grid(
  growout = c("g1","g2"),
  dtype   = c("raw","round"),
  method  = c("ZINB","NEGBIN"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# 3) Loop over them
for (i in seq_len(nrow(models))) {
  mm    <- models[i,]
  dat   <- if (mm$growout=="g1") dat1 else dat2
  data  <- dat[[ mm$dtype ]]
  meta  <- dat$meta

  outdir <- sprintf("mas_%s_%s_%s", 
                    mm$growout, mm$dtype, tolower(mm$method))
  
  message("Running ", mm$method, " on ", mm$growout, "/", mm$dtype, " -> ", outdir)
  
  Maaslin2(
    input_data      = data,
    input_metadata  = meta,
    output          = outdir,
    fixed_effects   = c("Treatment","Position"),
    reference = c('Treatment', 'Control'),
    random_effects  = "House",
    normalization   = "NONE",           # CSS already applied
    transform       = "NONE",           # GLM link handles scale
    analysis_method = mm$method,        # "ZINB" or "NEGBIN"
    min_prevalence  = 0.25
  )
}

```

```{r}
##Now for the collective dataset

## ---- 1) Prep: relabel Growout to G1/G2 (no factors) ----
prep_all_css <- function(phy) {
  # MaAsLin2 expects features in rows, samples in cols
  X <- as.data.frame(otu_table(phy))
  if (!taxa_are_rows(phy)) X <- as.data.frame(t(X))

  meta <- as(sample_data(phy), "data.frame")

  # Keep only growouts 1 & 2 if present
  keep <- as.character(meta$Growout) %in% c("1","2")
  meta <- meta[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  X    <- X[, rownames(meta), drop = FALSE]

  # Integerized copy for count models
  X_round <- X
  X_round[] <- lapply(X_round, function(z) as.numeric(round(z, 0)))

  # Leave Treatment/Position/House as-is (no factor casting)
  list(raw = X, round = X_round, meta = meta)
}

dat_all_css <- prep_all_css(physeq_no_growout3_css)

## ---- 2) Joint model specs ----
models_all <- expand.grid(
  dtype  = c("raw","round"),
  method = c("NEGBIN","ZINB"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

## ---- 3) Run MaAsLin2 jointly
for (i in seq_len(nrow(models_all))) {
  mm   <- models_all[i, ]
  X    <- dat_all_css[[ mm$dtype ]]
  meta <- dat_all_css$meta

  # Align samples
  common <- intersect(colnames(X), rownames(meta))
  X      <- X[, common, drop = FALSE]
  meta   <- meta[common, , drop = FALSE]

  outdir <- sprintf("mas_all_%s_%s", mm$dtype, tolower(mm$method))
  message("Running joint MaAsLin2: ", mm$method, " on ", mm$dtype, " -> ", outdir)

  Maaslin2(
    input_data      = X,
    input_metadata  = meta,
    output          = outdir,
    fixed_effects   = c("Treatment","Position","Growout"),
    reference       = c("Treatment","Control",
                        "Position","A",
                        "Growout","G1"),
    random_effects  = "House",
    normalization   = "NONE",
    transform       = "NONE",
    analysis_method = mm$method,
    min_prevalence  = 0.25,
    plot_heatmap    = FALSE,
    plot_scatter    = FALSE
  )
}


```

```{r}
## ===== 1) Base analysis directory =====
base_dir <- "/Users/brett/Documents/DeQueen_Litter/DeQueen litter analysis"

## ===== 2) Get list of relevant species-level runs =====
wanted_species <- c(
  # per-growout (existing 8)
  "mas_g1_raw_zinb",
  "mas_g1_raw_negbin",
  "mas_g1_round_zinb",
  "mas_g1_round_negbin",
  "mas_g2_raw_zinb",
  "mas_g2_raw_negbin",
  "mas_g2_round_zinb",
  "mas_g2_round_negbin",
  # collective (new 4)
  "mas_all_raw_zinb",
  "mas_all_raw_negbin",
  "mas_all_round_zinb",
  "mas_all_round_negbin"
)

## ===== 3) Build full paths and error if any are missing =====
mas_dirs_species <- file.path(base_dir, wanted_species)
missing_dirs <- mas_dirs_species[!dir.exists(mas_dirs_species)]
if (length(missing_dirs)) {
  stop("Missing these species-level runs:\n", paste(missing_dirs, collapse = "\n"))
}

## ===== 4) Read each all_results.tsv into a named list (force `value` -> character) =====
all_results_species <- lapply(mas_dirs_species, function(dir) {
  tsv <- file.path(dir, "all_results.tsv")
  if (!file.exists(tsv)) stop("Missing all_results.tsv in ", dir)
  
  # **FIX:** Use read_tsv with explicit col_types to handle mixed data types
  # This is the most robust way to ensure consistency
  df <- readr::read_tsv(tsv, col_types = cols(.default = col_guess(), value = col_character()))

  # A more targeted conversion for other columns that should be numeric
  for (nm in c("coef","stderr","pval","qval","N","N.not.0")) {
    if (nm %in% names(df)) suppressWarnings(df[[nm]] <- as.numeric(df[[nm]]))
  }

  # Keep track of the run
  df$Run <- basename(dir)
  df
})
names(all_results_species) <- wanted_species

## ===== 5) Combine into one big data.frame =====
combined_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_results_species)

combined_results_enriched <- combined_results %>%
  # be safe about numeric types
  mutate(
    qval = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(qval)),
    coef = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(coef))
  ) %>%
  # 1) break Run (e.g., "mas_g1_raw_zinb" or "mas_all_raw_negbin") into 4 parts
  separate(
    col    = Run,
    into   = c("mas", "Growout_code", "Data", "Method"),
    sep    = "_",
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  # 2) derive the real columns
  mutate(
    Growout = case_when(
      Growout_code == "g1"  ~ "1",
      Growout_code == "g2"  ~ "2",
      Growout_code == "all" ~ "Collective",
      TRUE                  ~ Growout_code
    ),
    Rounded = if_else(Data == "raw", "Not rounded", "Rounded"),
    Model   = case_when(
      tolower(Method) == "zinb"   ~ "ZINB",
      tolower(Method) == "negbin" ~ "Negative Binomial",
      tolower(Method) == "lm"     ~ "LM",
      tolower(Method) == "cplm"   ~ "CPLM",
      TRUE                        ~ Method
    ),
    Network = paste(Growout, Model, Rounded, sep = "-")
  ) %>%
  # 3) apply significance filter
  filter(!is.na(qval), qval <= 0.05) %>%
  # 4) MaAsLin2-style signed significance score
  mutate(significance = -log(qval) * sign(coef)) %>%
  # (optionally drop the helper cols)
  dplyr::select(-mas, -Growout_code, -Data, -Method)

# take a peek
head(combined_results_enriched)

## Filter to Treatment results only
treatment_results <- combined_results_enriched %>%
  filter(metadata == "Treatment") %>%
  mutate(Level = "Species")

```

```{r}
##Since we are having issues setting the reference level for the global model, let's manually change the sign of "coef" and "significance" to properly show the 
##change between treatments
##We know this is an admissable route based on this forum: https://forum.biobakery.org/t/setting-reference-levels-with-2-factors/2568
##we can also manually check that we are making the correct changes based on Enterococcus hirae levels:

# ---- 1) Locate Enterococcus hirae in taxonomy ----
phy <- physeq_no_growout3_css
taxdf <- as.data.frame(tax_table(phy))

# try exact, dotted, and a regex fallback
species_targets <- c("Enterococcus hirae", "Enterococcus.hirae")
idx <- integer(0)
if ("Species" %in% names(taxdf)) {
  idx <- which(taxdf$Species %in% species_targets)
  if (!length(idx)) {
    s_clean <- gsub("[._]", " ", as.character(taxdf$Species))
    idx <- which(tolower(s_clean) == "enterococcus hirae")
  }
  if (!length(idx)) {
    idx <- grep("(?i)^enterococcus[ ._]*hirae$", as.character(taxdf$Species), perl = TRUE)
  }
}
# final fallback: search any tax rank text
if (!length(idx)) {
  any_rank <- apply(taxdf, 1, function(x) paste(x, collapse = " "))
  idx <- grep("(?i)enterococcus[ ._]*hirae", any_rank, perl = TRUE)
}

if (!length(idx)) stop("No taxa matching 'Enterococcus hirae' found in taxonomy.")

taxa_hit <- rownames(taxdf)[idx]
message("Matched taxa: ", paste(taxa_hit, collapse = ", "))

# ---- 2) Build abundance vector (CSS) for those taxa ----
OTU <- as(otu_table(phy), "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(phy)) OTU <- t(OTU)

# aggregate across all matched taxa (if multiple)
eh_abund <- colSums(OTU[intersect(taxa_hit, rownames(OTU)), , drop = FALSE])

# ---- 3) Build plotting frame with metadata ----
meta <- as(sample_data(phy), "data.frame")
meta$Sample <- rownames(meta)
df_plot <- data.frame(Sample = names(eh_abund), Abund = as.numeric(eh_abund)) %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = factor(Treatment),     # ensure proper labels (Control / IndigoLT)
    Growout   = factor(Growout)        # should be "1","2"
  )

# ---- 4) Quick numeric check: which Treatment is higher? ----
summary_tbl <- df_plot %>%
  group_by(Growout, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(n = dplyr::n(), mean = mean(Abund), median = median(Abund), .groups = "drop")
print(summary_tbl)

# ---- 5) Plot by Treatment, faceted by Growout ----
p_eh <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = Treatment, y = Abund + 1)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = "grey85", color = "black") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0, size = 1.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~ Growout, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Enterococcus hirae (CSS abundance)",
    x = NULL, y = "CSS abundance (+1, log10 scale)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    axis.text  = element_text(color = "black")
  )

print(p_eh)

#########
##make the correction
treatment_results <- treatment_results %>%
  mutate(
    value = as.character(value),
    needs_fix = (Growout == "Collective" &
                 metadata == "Treatment" &
                 !(value %in% c("Control","IndigoLT"))),
    needs_fix = replace_na(needs_fix, FALSE),
    value        = if_else(needs_fix, "IndigoLT", value),
    coef         = if_else(needs_fix, -coef, coef),
    significance = if_else(needs_fix, -significance, significance)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-needs_fix)

```


```{r}
##Let's make the first heatmap

# 1) Pivot into matrix form
maas_matrix <- treatment_results %>%
  dplyr::select(feature, Network, significance) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = Network,
    values_from = significance,
    values_fill = NA
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("feature")

# 2) Clean up rownames
rownames(maas_matrix) <- gsub("\\.", " ", rownames(maas_matrix))
maas_matrix <- maas_matrix[rownames(maas_matrix) != "Unknown", ]

# 3) Build the per-column metadata from the column names
col_params <- lapply(colnames(maas_matrix), function(col) {
  parts <- strsplit(col, "-", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  list(
    Growout = parts[1],
    Model   = ifelse(grepl("ZINB", col), "ZINB", "NB"),
    Rounded = ifelse(grepl("Not rounded", col), "Not Rounded", "Rounded")
  )
})
metadata_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(col_params, as.data.frame))
rownames(metadata_df) <- colnames(maas_matrix)

# 4) Define annotation colors
annotation_colors <- list(
  Growout = c("1" = "#dbe9ff",  "2" = "#ffe8d5", "Collective" = "#000004"),
  Model   = c("NB" = "#f8765c", "ZINB" = "#221150"),
  Rounded = c("Rounded" = "#d3436e", "Not Rounded" = "#fcfdbf")
)

# 5) Build the column annotation object
col_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  df = metadata_df,
  which = "col",
  col = annotation_colors,
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  annotation_legend_param = list(border = TRUE),
  simple_anno_size = unit(0.2, "cm"), 
  show_legend = TRUE,
  gp = gpar(col = "black")
)

# 6) Define blue–white–red palette centered at zero
pal <- colorRamp2(c(-10, 0, 10), c("royalblue4", "white", "firebrick"))

# 7) Define custom legend parameters
lgd_list.mas <- list(
  title = expression(Log[2]~FC),         # Log₂FC
  title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"),
  labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  border = "black", lwd = 1,
  direction = "horizontal",
  title_position = "topcenter",
  at = c(-10.1, -5, -2.5, 0, 2.5, 5, 10.1),
  labels = c("<-10", "-5", "-2.5", "0", "2.5", "5", ">10"),
  legend_width = unit(5, "cm"),
  legend_height = unit(5, "cm"),
  x = unit(0.5, "cm"), y = unit(0.5, "cm"),
  legend_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 2)
)

# 2) Redraw your heatmap, injecting these legend params
ht <- Heatmap(
  maas_matrix,
  name = "Log₂FC",          # name is ignored when heatmap_legend_param$title is set,
  na_col = "gray99",
  col = pal,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  bottom_annotation = col_anno,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontface = "italic", fontsize = 10),
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "gray", lwd = 1),
  border_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1.5),
  heatmap_legend_param = lgd_list.mas
)

# 3) Draw (or save) it:
draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "bottom")

tiff("species.heat.newanalysis.png", width = 4, height = 7, units = "in", res = 900, bg = "transparent")

ht.2 <- draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "bottom")

dev.off()
```

```{r}
##Now for genus-level maaslin analysis

# 0) Agglomerate to Genus
phy_genus <- tax_glom(physeq_no_growout3_css, taxrank = "Genus")

# 1) Extract & prepare tables (CSS counts already in phyloseq)
prep <- function(phy) {
  df_raw     <- as.data.frame(otu_table(phy))
  df_round   <- df_raw
  df_round[] <- lapply(df_round, round)    # integerize for count models
  meta       <- as(sample_data(phy), "data.frame")
  list(raw = df_raw, round = df_round, meta = meta)
}

# subset by growout, *on the genus‐level object*
phy_g1_genus <- subset_samples(phy_genus, Growout == "1")
phy_g2_genus <- subset_samples(phy_genus, Growout == "2")

dat1_genus <- prep(phy_g1_genus)
dat2_genus <- prep(phy_g2_genus)

# 2) Define the eight model‐specs
models <- expand.grid(
  growout = c("g1", "g2"),
  dtype   = c("raw", "round"),
  method  = c("ZINB", "NEGBIN"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# 3) Loop over them, suffixing all outputs with “.genus”
for (i in seq_len(nrow(models))) {
  mm   <- models[i, ]
  dat  <- if (mm$growout == "g1") dat1_genus else dat2_genus
  data <- dat[[ mm$dtype ]]
  meta <- dat$meta

  outdir <- sprintf("mas_%s_%s_%s.genus",
                    mm$growout, mm$dtype, tolower(mm$method))
  
  message("Running ", mm$method,
          " on growout=", mm$growout,
          ", data=", mm$dtype,
          "  ->  ", outdir)

  Maaslin2(
    input_data      = data,
    input_metadata  = meta,
    output          = outdir,
    fixed_effects   = c("Treatment", "Position"),
    reference       = c("Treatment", "Control"),
    random_effects  = "House",
    normalization   = "NONE",    # CSS already applied
    transform       = "NONE",    # GLM link handles scale
    analysis_method = mm$method, # "ZINB" or "NEGBIN"
    min_prevalence  = 0.25
  )
}

```

```{r}
##Genus-level maaslin2 for the collective dataset

# --- Prep (features rows, samples columns; raw + rounded; aligned to metadata) ---
prep_genus_all <- function(phy) {
  mat <- as(otu_table(phy), "matrix")
  if (!taxa_are_rows(phy)) mat <- t(mat)  # features (genera) as rows
  
  df_raw   <- as.data.frame(mat, check.names = FALSE)
  df_round <- df_raw
  df_round[] <- lapply(df_round, round)   # integerize for count models
  
  meta <- as(sample_data(phy), "data.frame")
  
  # Align columns of data with metadata rows (sample IDs)
  keep <- intersect(colnames(df_raw), rownames(meta))
  df_raw   <- df_raw[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  df_round <- df_round[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  meta     <- meta[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  
  # Ensure factors for fixed/random effects
  meta$Treatment <- factor(meta$Treatment)
  meta$Position  <- factor(meta$Position)
  meta$Growout   <- factor(meta$Growout)   # levels "1","2"
  meta$House     <- factor(meta$House)
  
  list(raw = df_raw, round = df_round, meta = meta)
}

dat_all_genus <- prep_genus_all(phy_genus)

# --- Model specs (collective only): raw/round × ZINB/NEGBIN ---
models_genus_all <- expand.grid(
  dtype  = c("raw", "round"),
  method = c("ZINB", "NEGBIN"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# --- Run MaAsLin2 for each spec; include Growout as fixed effect ---
for (i in seq_len(nrow(models_genus_all))) {
  mm   <- models_genus_all[i, ]
  data <- dat_all_genus[[ mm$dtype ]]
  meta <- dat_all_genus$meta
  
  outdir <- sprintf("mas_all_%s_%s.genus",
                    mm$dtype, tolower(mm$method))
  
  message("Running ", mm$method,
          " on collective genus data, data=", mm$dtype,
          "  ->  ", outdir)
  
  Maaslin2(
    input_data      = data,
    input_metadata  = meta,
    output          = outdir,
    fixed_effects   = c("Treatment", "Position", "Growout"),
    reference       = c("Treatment", "Control", "Growout", "1"),
    random_effects  = "House",
    normalization   = "NONE",    # CSS already applied
    transform       = "NONE",    # GLM link handles scale
    analysis_method = mm$method, # "ZINB" or "NEGBIN"
    min_prevalence  = 0.25
  )
}

```

```{r}
##Extract results and craft df

## ===== 1) Base analysis directory =====
base_dir <- "/Users/brett/Documents/DeQueen_Litter/DeQueen litter analysis"

## ===== 2) Include the 4 collective genus-level runs in addition to the original 8 =====
wanted_genus <- c(
  # per-growout (existing 8)
  "mas_g1_raw_zinb.genus",
  "mas_g1_raw_negbin.genus",
  "mas_g1_round_zinb.genus",
  "mas_g1_round_negbin.genus",
  "mas_g2_raw_zinb.genus",
  "mas_g2_raw_negbin.genus",
  "mas_g2_round_zinb.genus",
  "mas_g2_round_negbin.genus",
  # collective (new 4)
  "mas_all_raw_zinb.genus",
  "mas_all_raw_negbin.genus",
  "mas_all_round_zinb.genus",
  "mas_all_round_negbin.genus"
)

## ===== 3) Build full paths and error if any are missing =====
mas_dirs_genus <- file.path(base_dir, wanted_genus)
missing_dirs <- mas_dirs_genus[!dir.exists(mas_dirs_genus)]
if (length(missing_dirs)) {
  stop("Missing these genus-level runs:\n", paste(missing_dirs, collapse = "\n"))
}

## ===== 4) Read each all_results.tsv into a named list (force `value` -> character) =====
all_results_genus <- lapply(mas_dirs_genus, function(dir) {
  tsv <- file.path(dir, "all_results.tsv")
  if (!file.exists(tsv)) stop("Missing all_results.tsv in ", dir)

  df <- read.delim(tsv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, sep = "\t", header = TRUE)

  # **FIX:** Ensure `value` column is character.
  if ("value" %in% names(df)) {
    df$value <- as.character(df$value)
  } else {
    df$value <- NA_character_
  }

  # Helpful numeric coercions (only if present)
  for (nm in c("coef", "stderr", "pval", "qval", "N", "N.not.0")) {
    if (nm %in% names(df)) suppressWarnings(df[[nm]] <- as.numeric(df[[nm]]))
  }

  # Keep track of the run
  df$Run <- basename(dir)
  df
})
names(all_results_genus) <- wanted_genus

## ===== 5) Combine into one big data.frame (no type clashes now) =====
combined_genus <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_results_genus)

## ===== 6) Enrich to mirror species (Scope, DataType, Growout, Model, Network); filter & score =====
combined_genus_enriched <- combined_genus %>%
  # split "mas_g1_raw_zinb.genus" / "mas_all_raw_zinb.genus"
  separate(
    col    = Run,
    into   = c("mas", "Growout_code", "Data", "MethodSuffix"),
    sep    = "_",
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  # strip ".genus" from the method
  mutate(Method = sub("\\.genus$", "", MethodSuffix)) %>%
  # match species fields
  mutate(
    Scope    = Growout_code,              # g1 / g2 / all
    DataType = Data,                      # raw / round
    Growout  = case_when(
      Growout_code == "g1"  ~ "1",
      Growout_code == "g2"  ~ "2",
      Growout_code == "all" ~ "Collective",
      TRUE                  ~ Growout_code
    ),
    Rounded = if_else(Data == "raw", "Not rounded", "Rounded"),
    Model    = case_when(
      grepl("zinb",   Method, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "ZINB",
      grepl("negbin", Method, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Negative Binomial",
      grepl("lm",     Method, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "LM",
      grepl("cplm",   Method, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "CPLM",
      TRUE                                        ~ Method
    ),
    Network = paste(Growout, Model, Rounded, sep = "-")
  ) %>%
  # significance filter (match species)
  filter(!is.na(qval), qval <= 0.05) %>%
  # signed significance score
  mutate(significance = -log(qval) * sign(coef)) %>%
  # label this table's level
  mutate(Level = "Genus") %>%
  # drop helper columns
  dplyr::select(-mas, -Data, -MethodSuffix, -Method)

## ===== 7) Treatment-only results (genus level) =====
treatment_genus_results <- combined_genus_enriched %>%
  filter(metadata == "Treatment")

## ===== 8) Apply the same "Collective" fix used for species =====
treatment_genus_results <- treatment_genus_results %>%
  mutate(
    needs_fix = (Scope == "all" & metadata == "Treatment" &
                 !value %in% c("Control","IndigoLT")),
    value         = if_else(needs_fix, "IndigoLT", value),
    coef          = if_else(needs_fix, -coef, coef),
    significance  = if_else(needs_fix, -significance, significance)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-needs_fix)

```

```{r}
##Let's now integrate the cplm analysis 

pick_ref <- function(x, preferred = "A") {
  x <- as.character(x)
  tab <- sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE)
  if (preferred %in% names(tab)) preferred else names(tab)[1]
}

run_cplm <- function(name, dat) {
  X    <- dat$raw
  meta <- dat$meta

  # align samples
  common <- intersect(colnames(X), rownames(meta))
  X      <- X[, common, drop = FALSE]
  meta   <- meta[common, , drop = FALSE]

  # ensure factors and choose a valid Position ref
  meta$Treatment <- factor(meta$Treatment)
  meta$Position  <- factor(meta$Position)
  pos_ref <- pick_ref(meta$Position, preferred = "A")

  outdir <- sprintf("mas_%s_raw_cplm", name)
  message("Running CPLM on ", name, " -> ", outdir, " (Position ref = ", pos_ref, ")")

  Maaslin2(
    input_data      = X,
    input_metadata  = meta,
    output          = outdir,
    fixed_effects   = c("Treatment","Position"),
    reference       = c("Treatment","Control",
                        "Position", pos_ref),
    random_effects  = "House",
    normalization   = "NONE",
    transform       = "NONE",
    analysis_method = "CPLM",
    min_prevalence  = 0.25
  )
}

# use your existing dat1 / dat2
run_cplm("g1", dat1)
run_cplm("g2", dat2)

```

```{r}
##Now for cplm at genus
## Helper: choose a safe reference level
pick_ref <- function(x, preferred = "A") {
  x <- as.character(x)
  tab <- sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE)
  if (preferred %in% names(tab)) preferred else names(tab)[1]
}

## ---------- Per-growout CPLM on genus-level (unrounded) ----------
run_cplm_genus <- function(name, dat) {
  X    <- dat$raw               # unrounded CSS counts
  meta <- dat$meta

  # align samples
  common <- intersect(colnames(X), rownames(meta))
  X      <- X[, common, drop = FALSE]
  meta   <- meta[common, , drop = FALSE]

  # factors + references
  meta$Treatment <- factor(meta$Treatment)
  meta$Position  <- factor(meta$Position)
  pos_ref <- pick_ref(meta$Position, preferred = "A")

  outdir <- sprintf("mas_%s_raw_cplm.genus", name)
  message("Genus CPLM ", name, " -> ", outdir, " (Position ref = ", pos_ref, ")")

  Maaslin2(
    input_data      = X,
    input_metadata  = meta,
    output          = outdir,
    fixed_effects   = c("Treatment","Position"),
    reference       = c("Treatment","Control",
                        "Position", pos_ref),
    random_effects  = "House",
    normalization   = "NONE",
    transform       = "NONE",
    analysis_method = "CPLM",
    min_prevalence  = 0.25
  )
}

# Run for Growout 1 and 2 genus objects you already prepared
run_cplm_genus("g1", dat1_genus)
run_cplm_genus("g2", dat2_genus)


## ---------- Joint CPLM on genus-level (Growouts 1 & 2 together) ----------
Xg_all    <- dat_all_genus$raw
metag_all <- dat_all_genus$meta

# align
common_all <- intersect(colnames(Xg_all), rownames(metag_all))
Xg_all     <- Xg_all[, common_all, drop = FALSE]
metag_all  <- metag_all[common_all, , drop = FALSE]

# factors + references
metag_all$Treatment <- factor(metag_all$Treatment)
metag_all$Position  <- factor(metag_all$Position)
metag_all$Growout   <- factor(metag_all$Growout)  # expected levels "1","2"
pos_ref_all <- pick_ref(metag_all$Position, preferred = "A")
grow_ref    <- if ("1" %in% levels(metag_all$Growout)) "1" else levels(metag_all$Growout)[1]

outdir_all_genus <- "mas_all_raw_cplm.genus"
message("Genus CPLM (joint) -> ", outdir_all_genus,
        " (Position ref = ", pos_ref_all, ", Growout ref = ", grow_ref, ")")

Maaslin2(
  input_data      = Xg_all,
  input_metadata  = metag_all,

  fixed_effects   = c("Treatment","Position","Growout"),
  reference       = c("Treatment","Control",
                      "Position", pos_ref_all,
                      "Growout",  grow_ref),
  random_effects  = "House",
  normalization   = "NONE",
  transform       = "NONE",
  analysis_method = "CPLM",
  min_prevalence  = 0.25,
  plot_heatmap    = FALSE,
  plot_scatter    = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
##Let's pull out significant results

## 1) Point to your MaAsLin2 results root
base_dir <- "/Users/brett/Documents/DeQueen_Litter/DeQueen litter analysis"

## 2) Discover CPLM run folders automatically
all_dirs <- list.dirs(base_dir, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
cplm_dirs <- all_dirs[grepl("_cplm(\\.genus)?$", basename(all_dirs), ignore.case = TRUE)]

if (!length(cplm_dirs)) {
  stop("No CPLM result folders found under:\n", base_dir)
}

message("Found CPLM folders:\n- ", paste(basename(cplm_dirs), collapse = "\n- "))

## 3) Reader for MaAsLin2 tables (robust casting)
read_mas <- function(dir_path) {
  tsv <- file.path(dir_path, "all_results.tsv")
  if (!file.exists(tsv)) stop("Missing all_results.tsv in ", dir_path)

  df <- readr::read_tsv(
    tsv,
    col_types = cols(.default = col_guess(), value = col_character())
  )

  # numeric columns when present
  for (nm in intersect(c("coef","stderr","pval","qval","N","N.not.0"), names(df))) {
    df[[nm]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[nm]]))
  }

  df$Run   <- basename(dir_path)
  df$Level <- ifelse(grepl("\\.genus$", df$Run, ignore.case = TRUE), "Genus", "Species")
  df
}

## 4) Load all discovered runs
all_cplm <- do.call(bind_rows, lapply(cplm_dirs, read_mas))

## 5) Parse run name, filter to CPLM + Treatment, q ≤ 0.05, compute significance
all_cplm$Run_clean <- sub("\\.genus$", "", all_cplm$Run, ignore.case = TRUE)

combined_cplm_sig <- all_cplm %>%
  mutate(
    qval = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(qval)),
    coef = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(coef))
  ) %>%
  separate(
    col    = Run_clean,
    into   = c("mas", "Growout_code", "Data", "Method"),
    sep    = "_",
    remove = FALSE,
    fill   = "right"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Growout = case_when(
      Growout_code == "g1"  ~ "1",
      Growout_code == "g2"  ~ "2",
      Growout_code == "all" ~ "Collective",
      TRUE                  ~ Growout_code
    ),
    Rounded = if_else(Data == "raw", "Not rounded", "Rounded"),
    Model   = if_else(tolower(Method) == "cplm", "CPLM", Method),
    significance = -log(qval) * sign(coef)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    tolower(Model) == "cplm",
    metadata == "Treatment",
    !is.na(qval), qval <= 0.05
  ) %>%
  select(
    Level, Run, feature, metadata, value, coef, stderr, pval, qval,
    significance, Growout, Rounded, Model
  ) %>%
  arrange(Level, Growout, desc(significance))

# Peek
head(combined_cplm_sig)
```

```{r}
  mutate(feature = if_else(

    sub("\\..*$", "", feature),

    missing = feature
  )) %>%
  # Remove env runs

##Fix species names
```

```{r}
##Let's craft an upset plot

## ----------------------------
## 0) Column order (your heatmap order)
## ----------------------------
sets_order <- c(
  "Collective-CPLM-Not Rounded",
  "Collective-ZINB-Rounded",
  "Collective-ZINB-Not Rounded",
  "Collective-NEGBIN-Not Rounded",
  "Collective-NEGBIN-Rounded",
  "1-ZINB-Not Rounded",
  "1-ZINB-Rounded",
  "1-CPLM-Not Rounded",
  "1-NEGBIN-Rounded",
  "1-NEGBIN-Not Rounded",
  "2-CPLM-Not Rounded",
  "2-NEGBIN-Rounded",
  "2-NEGBIN-Not Rounded",
  "2-ZINB-Rounded",
  "2-ZINB-Not Rounded"
)

## keep only available columns, preserve order
sets_order <- sets_order[sets_order %in% colnames(maas_matrix_cplmht)]
maas_matrix_cplmht <- maas_matrix_cplmht[, sets_order, drop = FALSE]

## column metadata in the same order
colmeta_cplmht <- data.frame(
  set      = sets_order,
  Growout  = sub("^([^\\-]+).*", "\\1", sets_order),
  Model    = sub("^[^\\-]+\\-([^\\-]+).*", "\\1", sets_order),
  Rounded  = sub("^[^\\-]+\\-[^\\-]+\\-(.*)$", "\\1", sets_order),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
colmeta_cplmht$set_x <- seq_len(nrow(colmeta_cplmht))

## ----------------------------
## 1) Presence matrix → combos
## ----------------------------
present_df <- data.frame(item = rownames(maas_matrix_cplmht), check.names = FALSE)
for (s in sets_order) present_df[[s]] <- !is.na(maas_matrix_cplmht[, s])

present_df$combo_label <- apply(present_df[sets_order], 1, function(row) {
  on <- sets_order[as.logical(row)]
  if (length(on) == 0) "(none)" else paste(on, collapse = " ∩ ")
})

combo_sizes <- present_df |>
  dplyr::count(combo_label) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n))
combo_levels_plot <- rev(combo_sizes$combo_label)

long_mat <- present_df |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols      = dplyr::all_of(sets_order),
    names_to  = "set",
    values_to = "present"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(colmeta_cplmht, by = "set") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    set         = factor(set, levels = sets_order),
    combo_label = factor(combo_label, levels = combo_levels_plot),
    Growout     = factor(Growout, levels = c("Collective","1","2")),
    Model       = factor(Model,   levels = c("NEGBIN","ZINB","CPLM")),
    Rounded     = factor(Rounded, levels = c("Rounded","Not Rounded"))
  )

## connector segments per combo
seg_df <- long_mat |>
  dplyr::filter(present) |>
  dplyr::group_by(combo_label) |>
  dplyr::summarise(x_min = min(set_x), x_max = max(set_x), .groups = "drop")

## ----------------------------
## 2) GRID (left) — Growout bands + theme_bw gridlines
## ----------------------------
grow_cols_bg <- c("1" = "#dbe9ff", "2" = "#ffe8d5", "Collective" = "#000004")
grow_band_df <- colmeta_cplmht |>
  dplyr::group_by(Growout) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    xmin = min(set_x) - 0.5,
    xmax = max(set_x) + 0.5,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## vertical padding to keep dots off the borders (use same for both panels)
y_expansion <- ggplot2::expansion(add = 0.6)

p_matrix <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
  # Growout bands (underlay)
  ggplot2::geom_rect(
    data = grow_band_df,
    ggplot2::aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = Growout),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.5, color = NA
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = grow_cols_bg, guide = "none") +
  # connectors
  ggplot2::geom_segment(
    data = seg_df,
    ggplot2::aes(y = combo_label, yend = combo_label, x = x_min, xend = x_max),
    linewidth = 0.7, color = "grey20"
  ) +
  # background empty dots
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    data = long_mat,
    ggplot2::aes(x = set_x, y = combo_label),
    shape = 21, size = 4.5, color = "black", fill = "white", stroke = 0.3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  # present dots
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    data = long_mat |> dplyr::filter(present),
    ggplot2::aes(x = set_x, y = combo_label),
    shape = 21, size = 4.5, color = "black", fill = "black", stroke = 0.3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = colmeta_cplmht$set_x,
    labels = NULL,
    limits = c(min(colmeta_cplmht$set_x) - 0.5, max(colmeta_cplmht$set_x) + 0.5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(expand = y_expansion) +
  ggplot2::coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_line(color = "grey93", linewidth = 0.2),
    panel.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    axis.ticks       = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.text        = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.border     = ggplot2::element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
    plot.margin      = grid::unit(c(2, 0, 0, 4), "pt")
  )

## ----------------------------
## 3) Footer (Rounded/Model/Growout) — tiles touch (no gaps)
## ----------------------------
header_fill_map <- c(
  "Rounded" = "#d3436e", "Not Rounded" = "#fcfdbf",
  "NEGBIN" = "#f8765c", "ZINB" = "#221150", "CPLM" = "#148F77",
  "1" = "#dbe9ff", "2" = "#ffe8d5", "Collective" = "#000004"
)

footer_long <- colmeta_cplmht |>
  dplyr::select(set, set_x, Rounded, Model, Growout) |>   # <-- fixed closing parenthesis here
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Rounded, Model, Growout),
    names_to = "Track", values_to = "Value"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Track = factor(Track, levels = c("Rounded","Model","Growout")))

p_footer <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  footer_long,
  ggplot2::aes(x = set_x, y = Track, fill = Value)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_tile(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2, height = 1.0) +  # tiles touch
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = colmeta_cplmht$set_x,
    labels = NULL,
    limits = c(min(colmeta_cplmht$set_x) - 0.5, max(colmeta_cplmht$set_x) + 0.5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +                         # no vertical gaps
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = header_fill_map, guide = "none") +
  ggplot2::coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    panel.grid       = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    axis.ticks       = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.text        = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.border     = ggplot2::element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
    plot.margin      = grid::unit(c(0, 0, 2, 4), "pt")
  )

## ----------------------------
## 4) Bars (right) — matched y-expansion
## ----------------------------
bars_df <- combo_sizes |>
  dplyr::mutate(combo_label = factor(combo_label, levels = combo_levels_plot))

p_bars <- ggplot2::ggplot(bars_df, ggplot2::aes(y = combo_label, x = n)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.6, fill = "grey25", color = "black") +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Intersection size", y = NULL) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(limits = levels(long_mat$combo_label),
                            expand = y_expansion) +
  ggplot2::coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    panel.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.border     = ggplot2::element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.title.x     = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x      = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.text.y      = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y     = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.title.y     = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    plot.margin      = grid::unit(c(2, 6, 4, 0), "pt")
  )

## ----------------------------
## 5) Arrange (thin footer; locked alignment)
## ----------------------------
footer_share <- 0.04

left_stack <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  p_matrix, p_footer,
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(1, footer_share),
  align = "v",
  axis  = "lr"
)

aligned <- cowplot::align_plots(left_stack, p_bars, align = "v", axis = "tb")

final_upset <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  aligned[[1]], aligned[[2]],
  ncol = 2,
  rel_widths = c(0.65, 0.35),
  align = "v",
  axis = "tb"
)

print(final_upset)

## Recommended save (stable text metrics) — optional:
ggsave("upset.da.3.png", final_upset, width = 7, height = 8, units = "in",
       dpi = 900, device = ragg::agg_png, bg = "white")
```

```{r}
##We will create this version, then manually clean up the stacked bar plot

## ----------------------------
## 0) Column order (your heatmap order)
## ----------------------------
sets_order <- c(
  "Collective-CPLM-Not Rounded",
  "Collective-ZINB-Rounded",
  "Collective-ZINB-Not Rounded",
  "Collective-NEGBIN-Not Rounded",
  "Collective-NEGBIN-Rounded",
  "1-ZINB-Not Rounded",
  "1-ZINB-Rounded",
  "1-CPLM-Not Rounded",
  "1-NEGBIN-Rounded",
  "1-NEGBIN-Not Rounded",
  "2-CPLM-Not Rounded",
  "2-NEGBIN-Rounded",
  "2-NEGBIN-Not Rounded",
  "2-ZINB-Rounded",
  "2-ZINB-Not Rounded"
)

## keep only available columns, preserve order
sets_order <- sets_order[sets_order %in% colnames(maas_matrix_cplmht)]
maas_matrix_cplmht <- maas_matrix_cplmht[, sets_order, drop = FALSE]

## column metadata in the same order
colmeta_cplmht <- data.frame(
  set      = sets_order,
  Growout  = sub("^([^\\-]+).*", "\\1", sets_order),
  Model    = sub("^[^\\-]+\\-([^\\-]+).*", "\\1", sets_order),
  Rounded  = sub("^[^\\-]+\\-[^\\-]+\\-(.*)$", "\\1", sets_order),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
colmeta_cplmht$set_x <- seq_len(nrow(colmeta_cplmht))

## ----------------------------
## 1) Presence matrix → combos
## ----------------------------
present_df <- data.frame(item = rownames(maas_matrix_cplmht), check.names = FALSE)
for (s in sets_order) present_df[[s]] <- !is.na(maas_matrix_cplmht[, s])

present_df$combo_label <- apply(present_df[sets_order], 1, function(row) {
  on <- sets_order[as.logical(row)]
  if (length(on) == 0) "(none)" else paste(on, collapse = " ∩ ")
})

combo_sizes <- present_df |>
  dplyr::count(combo_label) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n))
combo_levels_plot <- rev(combo_sizes$combo_label)

long_mat <- present_df |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols      = dplyr::all_of(sets_order),
    names_to  = "set",
    values_to = "present"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(colmeta_cplmht, by = "set") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    set         = factor(set, levels = sets_order),
    combo_label = factor(combo_label, levels = combo_levels_plot),
    Growout     = factor(Growout, levels = c("Collective","1","2")),
    Model       = factor(Model,   levels = c("NEGBIN","ZINB","CPLM")),
    Rounded     = factor(Rounded, levels = c("Rounded","Not Rounded"))
  )

## connector segments per combo
seg_df <- long_mat |>
  dplyr::filter(present) |>
  dplyr::group_by(combo_label) |>
  dplyr::summarise(x_min = min(set_x), x_max = max(set_x), .groups = "drop")

## ----------------------------
## 2) GRID (left) — Growout bands + theme_bw gridlines
## ----------------------------
grow_cols_bg <- c("1" = "#dbe9ff", "2" = "#ffe8d5", "Collective" = "#000004")
grow_band_df <- colmeta_cplmht |>
  dplyr::group_by(Growout) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    xmin = min(set_x) - 0.5,
    xmax = max(set_x) + 0.5,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## vertical padding to keep dots off the borders (use same for both panels)
y_expansion <- ggplot2::expansion(add = 0.6)

p_matrix <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::geom_rect(
    data = grow_band_df,
    ggplot2::aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = Growout),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.5, color = NA
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = grow_cols_bg, guide = "none") +
  ggplot2::geom_segment(
    data = seg_df,
    ggplot2::aes(y = combo_label, yend = combo_label, x = x_min, xend = x_max),
    linewidth = 0.7, color = "grey20"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    data = long_mat,
    ggplot2::aes(x = set_x, y = combo_label),
    shape = 21, size = 4.5, color = "black", fill = "white", stroke = 0.3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    data = long_mat |> dplyr::filter(present),
    ggplot2::aes(x = set_x, y = combo_label),
    shape = 21, size = 4.5, color = "black", fill = "black", stroke = 0.3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = colmeta_cplmht$set_x,
    labels = NULL,
    limits = c(min(colmeta_cplmht$set_x) - 0.5, max(colmeta_cplmht$set_x) + 0.5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(expand = y_expansion) +
  ggplot2::coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_line(color = "grey93", linewidth = 0.2),
    panel.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    axis.ticks       = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.text        = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.border     = ggplot2::element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
    plot.margin      = grid::unit(c(2, 0, 0, 4), "pt")
  )

## ----------------------------
## 3) Footer (Growout/Model/Rounded) — tiles touch (no gaps)
## ----------------------------
header_fill_map <- c(
  "1" = "#dbe9ff", "2" = "#ffe8d5", "Collective" = "#000004",
  "NEGBIN" = "#f8765c", "ZINB" = "#221150", "CPLM" = "#148F77",
  "Rounded" = "#d3436e", "Not Rounded" = "#fcfdbf"
)

footer_long <- colmeta_cplmht |>
  dplyr::select(set, set_x, Growout, Model, Rounded) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Growout, Model, Rounded),
    names_to = "Track", values_to = "Value"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Track = factor(Track, levels = c("Growout","Model","Rounded")))

p_footer <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  footer_long,
  ggplot2::aes(x = set_x, y = Track, fill = Value)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_tile(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2, height = 1.0) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = colmeta_cplmht$set_x,
    labels = NULL,
    limits = c(min(colmeta_cplmht$set_x) - 0.5, max(colmeta_cplmht$set_x) + 0.5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = header_fill_map, guide = "none") +
  ggplot2::coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    panel.grid       = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    axis.ticks       = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.text        = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.border     = ggplot2::element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
    plot.margin      = grid::unit(c(0, 0, 2, 4), "pt")
  )

## ----------------------------
## 4) Right bars — matched y-expansion
## ----------------------------
bars_df <- combo_sizes |>
  dplyr::mutate(combo_label = factor(combo_label, levels = combo_levels_plot))

p_bars <- ggplot2::ggplot(bars_df, ggplot2::aes(y = combo_label, x = n)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.6, fill = "grey25", color = "black") +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Intersection size", y = NULL) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(limits = levels(long_mat$combo_label),
                            expand = y_expansion) +
  ggplot2::coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    panel.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.border     = ggplot2::element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.title.x     = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x      = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.text.y      = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y     = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.title.y     = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    plot.margin      = grid::unit(c(2, 6, 4, 0), "pt")
  )

## ----------------------------
## 5) Top stacked bar plot (shorter; closer; left-edge hard-locked)
## ----------------------------
top_counts <- lapply(seq_along(sets_order), function(i) {
  s <- sets_order[i]
  v <- maas_matrix_cplmht[, s]
  v <- v[!is.na(v)]
  data.frame(
    set   = s,
    set_x = i,
    Negative = sum(v < 0),
    Positive = sum(v > 0),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})
top_counts <- do.call(rbind, top_counts)

top_counts_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(
  top_counts,
  cols = c("Negative", "Positive"),
  names_to = "Sign",
  values_to = "count"
)
top_counts_long$Sign <- factor(top_counts_long$Sign, levels = c("Negative","Positive"))

p_topbars <- ggplot2::ggplot(top_counts_long,
                             ggplot2::aes(x = set_x, y = count, fill = Sign)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.8, color = "black") +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = c(Negative = "royalblue4", Positive = "firebrick")) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = colmeta_cplmht$set_x,
    labels = NULL,
    limits = c(min(colmeta_cplmht$set_x) - 0.5, max(colmeta_cplmht$set_x) + 0.5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = "# features") +
  ggplot2::coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_line(color = "grey93", linewidth = 0.2),
    panel.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.border     = ggplot2::element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.text.x      = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = 'black'),
    axis.title.y = element_text(color = 'black', face = 'bold'),
    axis.ticks.x     = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "none",
    ## tighter gap above the grid:
    plot.margin      = grid::unit(c(2, 0, 0, 4), "pt")  # bottom = 0 to sit closer
  )

## ----------------------------
## 6) Assemble with hard width locking
## ----------------------------
footer_share <- 0.04   # thin footer
top_share    <- 0.09   # shorter top bars & closer to grid

## Left core (grid + footer)
left_core <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  p_matrix, p_footer,
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(1, footer_share),
  align = "v",
  axis  = "lr"
)

## Convert to gtables and force identical width columns (locks left panel borders)
g_top   <- ggplotGrob(p_topbars)
g_left  <- ggplotGrob(left_core)
common_w <- grid::unit.pmax(g_top$widths, g_left$widths)
g_top$widths  <- common_w
g_left$widths <- common_w

## Stack topbars over left_core with exact alignment
left_column <- gridExtra::arrangeGrob(
  grobs   = list(g_top, g_left),
  ncol    = 1,
  heights = grid::unit.c(grid::unit(top_share, "null"), grid::unit(1, "null"))
)

## Right column: spacer + right bars (keeps right bars aligned to grid area)
p_spacer <- ggplot2::ggplot() + ggplot2::theme_void()
right_column <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  p_spacer, p_bars,
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(top_share, 1),
  align = "v",
  axis  = "tb"
)

final_upset_with_top <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  left_column, right_column,
  ncol = 2,
  rel_widths = c(0.65, 0.35),
  align = "v",
  axis = "tb"
)

print(final_upset_with_top)

## Suggested save (stable metrics)
 ggsave("upset.da.with_top.png", final_upset_with_top,
        width = 7, height = 9, units = "in",
       dpi = 900, device = ragg::agg_png, bg = "white")
```

```{r}
##New heatmap with all values

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(stringr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)

alpha_fdr <- 0.05

# ============================================================
# 1. Build FULL, unfiltered ZINB/NEGBIN species results
# ============================================================

species_full <- combined_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    qval = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(qval)),
    coef = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(coef))
  ) %>%
  tidyr::separate(
    col = Run,
    into = c("mas", "Growout_code", "Data", "Method"),
    sep = "_",
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Level = "Species",
    Growout = dplyr::case_when(
      Growout_code == "g1"  ~ "1",
      Growout_code == "g2"  ~ "2",
      Growout_code == "all" ~ "Collective",
      TRUE ~ Growout_code
    ),
    Rounded = dplyr::if_else(Data == "raw", "Not Rounded", "Rounded"),
    Model = dplyr::case_when(
      tolower(Method) == "zinb"   ~ "ZINB",
      tolower(Method) == "negbin" ~ "NEGBIN",
      TRUE ~ toupper(Method)
    ),
    Network = paste(Growout, Model, Rounded, sep = "-"),
    feature = stringr::str_squish(stringr::str_replace_all(feature, "\\.", " "))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(metadata == "Treatment")

# ============================================================
# 2. Build FULL, unfiltered ZINB/NEGBIN genus results
# ============================================================

genus_full <- combined_genus %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    qval = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(qval)),
    coef = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(coef))
  ) %>%
  tidyr::separate(
    col = Run,
    into = c("mas", "Growout_code", "Data", "MethodSuffix"),
    sep = "_",
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Method = sub("\\.genus$", "", MethodSuffix),
    Level = "Genus",
    Growout = dplyr::case_when(
      Growout_code == "g1"  ~ "1",
      Growout_code == "g2"  ~ "2",
      Growout_code == "all" ~ "Collective",
      TRUE ~ Growout_code
    ),
    Rounded = dplyr::if_else(Data == "raw", "Not Rounded", "Rounded"),
    Model = dplyr::case_when(
      grepl("zinb", Method, ignore.case = TRUE)   ~ "ZINB",
      grepl("negbin", Method, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "NEGBIN",
      TRUE ~ toupper(Method)
    ),
    Network = paste(Growout, Model, Rounded, sep = "-"),
    feature = sub("\\..*$", "", feature)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(metadata == "Treatment")

# ============================================================
# 3. Build FULL, unfiltered CPLM results
# ============================================================

cplm_full <- all_cplm %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    qval = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(qval)),
    coef = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(coef)),
    Run_clean = sub("\\.genus$", "", Run, ignore.case = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::separate(
    col = Run_clean,
    into = c("mas", "Growout_code", "Data", "Method"),
    sep = "_",
    remove = FALSE,
    fill = "right"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Growout = dplyr::case_when(
      Growout_code == "g1"  ~ "1",
      Growout_code == "g2"  ~ "2",
      Growout_code == "all" ~ "Collective",
      TRUE ~ Growout_code
    ),
    Rounded = dplyr::if_else(Data == "raw", "Not Rounded", "Rounded"),
    Model = dplyr::case_when(
      tolower(Method) == "cplm" ~ "CPLM",
      TRUE ~ toupper(Method)
    ),
    Network = paste(Growout, Model, Rounded, sep = "-"),
    feature = dplyr::if_else(
      Level == "Genus",
      sub("\\..*$", "", feature),
      stringr::str_squish(stringr::str_replace_all(feature, "\\.", " "))
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    metadata == "Treatment",
    Model == "CPLM",
    Growout != "env"
  )

# ============================================================
# 4. Combine all full results and compute signed log-FDR metric
# ============================================================

maas_full_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  species_full,
  genus_full,
  cplm_full
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(qval), !is.na(coef), feature != "Unknown") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    feature = stringr::str_squish(feature),
    significance = -log(qval) * sign(coef),
    sig_mark = dplyr::case_when(
      qval < 0.001 ~ "***",
      qval < 0.01  ~ "**",
      qval < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    sig = qval < alpha_fdr
  )

# ============================================================
# 5. Apply Collective sign/reference fix
# ============================================================

maas_full_all <- maas_full_all %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    value = as.character(value),
    needs_fix = (
      Growout == "Collective" &
        metadata == "Treatment" &
        !(value %in% c("Control", "IndigoLT"))
    ),
    needs_fix = tidyr::replace_na(needs_fix, FALSE),
    value = dplyr::if_else(needs_fix, "IndigoLT", value),
    coef = dplyr::if_else(needs_fix, -coef, coef),
    significance = dplyr::if_else(needs_fix, -significance, significance)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-needs_fix)

# Keep taxa significant in at least one model/comparison
features_to_plot <- maas_full_all %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Level, feature) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(any_sig = any(sig, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::filter(any_sig)

plot_df <- maas_full_all %>%
  dplyr::semi_join(features_to_plot, by = c("Level", "feature"))

# ============================================================
# 6. Build significance matrix and asterisk matrix
# ============================================================

significance_mat_df <- plot_df %>%
  dplyr::select(Level, feature, Network, significance) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Level, feature, Network, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Row = paste(Level, feature, sep = " | ")) %>%
  dplyr::select(Row, Network, significance) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Network,
    values_from = significance,
    values_fill = NA_real_
  )

significance_mat <- significance_mat_df %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Row") %>%
  as.matrix()

sig_mark_mat_df <- plot_df %>%
  dplyr::select(Level, feature, Network, sig_mark) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Level, feature, Network, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Row = paste(Level, feature, sep = " | ")) %>%
  dplyr::select(Row, Network, sig_mark) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Network,
    values_from = sig_mark,
    values_fill = ""
  )

sig_mark_mat <- sig_mark_mat_df %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Row") %>%
  as.matrix()

sig_mark_mat <- sig_mark_mat[
  rownames(significance_mat),
  colnames(significance_mat),
  drop = FALSE
]

# Alphabetize rows and keep asterisks aligned
row_order <- sort(rownames(significance_mat), method = "radix")

significance_mat <- significance_mat[row_order, , drop = FALSE]
sig_mark_mat     <- sig_mark_mat[row_order, , drop = FALSE]

# ============================================================
# 7. Row and column metadata
# ============================================================

row_info <- data.frame(Row = rownames(significance_mat), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Level = sub(" \\| .*", "", Row),
    feature = sub(".* \\| ", "", Row)
  )

row_split <- factor(row_info$Level, levels = c("Genus", "Species"))
row_labels <- row_info$feature

colmeta <- do.call(rbind, lapply(colnames(significance_mat), function(cn) {
  parts <- strsplit(cn, "-", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  data.frame(
    Growout = parts[1],
    Model   = parts[2],
    Rounded = parts[3],
    row.names = cn,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

column_split_vec <- factor(
  colmeta$Growout,
  levels = c("Collective", "1", "2")
)

annotation_colors <- list(
  Growout = c("1" = "#dbe9ff", "2" = "#ffe8d5", "Collective" = "#000004"),
  Model   = c("NEGBIN" = "#f8765c", "ZINB" = "#221150", "CPLM" = "#148F77"),
  Rounded = c("Rounded" = "#d3436e", "Not Rounded" = "#fcfdbf")
)

col_anno <- ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(
  df = colmeta,
  which = "col",
  col = annotation_colors,
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  annotation_legend_param = list(border = TRUE),
  simple_anno_size = grid::unit(0.22, "cm"),
  gp = grid::gpar(col = "black")
)

# ============================================================
# 8. Palette and legend
# ============================================================

pal <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  c(-10, 0, 10),
  c("royalblue4", "white", "firebrick")
)

legend_params <- list(
  title = "FDR",
  title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"),
  labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10),
  border = "black",
  lwd = 1,
  direction = "horizontal",
  title_position = "topcenter",
  at = c(-10.1, -5, -2.5, 0, 2.5, 5, 10.1),
  labels = c("<-10", "-5", "-2.5", "0", "2.5", "5", ">10"),
  legend_width = grid::unit(5, "cm"),
  legend_height = grid::unit(5, "cm"),
  legend_gp = grid::gpar(col = "black", lwd = 2)
)

rowname_colors <- ifelse(
  grepl("\\bEnterococcus\\b", row_labels, ignore.case = TRUE),
  "red",
  "black"
)

# ============================================================
# 9. Heatmap: all values, no column names, darker NA, layer_fun
# ============================================================

ht_fdr <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
  significance_mat,
  name = "FDR",
  na_col = "gray80",
  col = pal,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  column_title = NULL,
  bottom_annotation = col_anno,
  row_split = row_split,
  column_split = column_split_vec,
  row_labels = row_labels,
  row_names_gp = grid::gpar(
    fontface = "italic",
    fontsize = 8,
    col = rowname_colors
  ),
  rect_gp = grid::gpar(col = "gray", lwd = 1),
  border_gp = grid::gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1.5),
  heatmap_legend_param = legend_params,
  layer_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    marks <- sig_mark_mat[cbind(i, j)]
    keep <- !is.na(marks) & marks != ""
    if (any(keep)) {
      grid::grid.text(
        marks[keep],
        x = x[keep],
        y = y[keep] - height[keep] * 0.25,
        gp = grid::gpar(
          col = "white",
          fontsize = 11,
          fontface = "bold"
        )
      )
    }
  }
)

ComplexHeatmap::draw(
  ht_fdr,
  heatmap_legend_side = "bottom",
  annotation_legend_side = "bottom",
  merge_legend = TRUE
)

png(
  "combined_maaslin_FDR_heatmap_all_values_with_CPLM.png",
  width = 5.5,
  height = 10,
  units = "in",
  res = 900,
  bg = "transparent"
)

ComplexHeatmap::draw(
  ht_fdr,
  heatmap_legend_side = "bottom",
  annotation_legend_side = "bottom",
  merge_legend = TRUE
)

dev.off()

```
